text: maya: quick thread on compare table layout alternatives. two proposals in figma: 'left-list' (compact rows, left-aligned name + version) vs 'card-grid' (larger cards, stacked badges). also a toggle for 'Performance view' vs 'Details view'. https://figma.redwood/compare-layouts sam: I prefer left-list for dense dashboards. card-grid feels like it forces extra vertical scrolling for customers who compare 8+ models. but cards are friendlier for newcomers. can we have a view toggle saved per workspace? :gear: elena: agree on view toggle, but accessibility-wise the toggle must be a real radiogroup not just button styling. screen readers need "Performance view selected" announcements. rui: a11y nit: in left-list, the version chip is too small to target. add at least 44x44 hit area for touch and keyboard. also add skip link "Skip to compare results". jamal: UX question about default sort: should pinned versions always float to top? product asked for a "lock" affordance so routes never auto-update. Lock vs Pin naming is confusing. maybe call it "Lock to version" with a tiny lock icon and tooltip: "Lock routes to this version (recommended for production)". maya: good rename. microcopy: use active voice "Locked to v3.2" and for un-lock "Unlocked". We should also show a subtle banner on top of compare when any locked model exists: "This workspace has locked versions. Some rollouts are pinned to specific versions." sam: on badges: performance-only mode should surface latency p50/p95 and cost-per-1k tokens. maybe allow switching units inline. also allow keyboard shortcut `G` to focus search and `/` to focus filter chips like GitHub. handy for power users. elena: make sure shortcuts are discoverable — add a small ? hotkey help modal. and ensure we register shortcuts with `aria-haspopup` and appropriate `role=\"dialog\"`. rui: screenreader announcement when shortcuts open help: `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-label=\"Keyboard shortcuts\"`. also when user toggles view, `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` with copy: "Switched to Performance view". jamal: thoughts on compare selection state: when selecting rows the toolbar shows actions. current design uses only icons and no accessible labels. add `aria-label` to each action button and ensure stateful toggles have `aria-pressed`. maya: agreed. Also want a condensed mode which hides long model descriptions by default but exposes an expand button per row. that can also be keyboard-expanded with Enter. add `aria-expanded` to the expand control. sam: visual contrast: in card-grid the badge background (teal) doesn't meet AA when badge text is numeric. propose swapping to darker teal or using bold 13px text. I'll run color tests. elena: another SR pattern: provide a table-mode that exposes the data as a semantic table for assistive tech. left-list can be built as a table with sortable headers and `scope` attributes. For complex interactions we can keep ARIA grid when interactions are row-level. rui: implementation note: when persisting view preference per workspace, ensure users can opt-out or clear cache. expose a settings link: "Clear compare preferences" under workspace settings. also log events for telemetry: `compare.view_changed` with payload `{view: "performance", workspace_id: "..."}`. maya: small copy bike-shed: the toggle label should be "Performance" / "Details" not "Perf" / "Details". keep consistent capitalization. jamal: also propose a temporary banner when switching between views for the first time: "You switched to Performance view. Press ? to see shortcuts. Undo". helps on discoverability. sam: for keyboard focus outlines, please don't use custom blur-only rings that disappear on focus. keep visible 2px outline with accessible color. elena: agreed. I'll prototype an alternative where the focus ring is 3px for dark mode and uses an accessible yellow contrast. maya: action items: 1) implement view toggle radiogroup + aria-live announcements (elena/rui) 2) add skip link + 44px hit area for chips/version controls (rui) 3) rename Pin -> Lock and add top banner + locked microcopy (jamal/maya) 4) add hotkey `?` help modal + track shortcuts usage (sam/elena) 5) ensure action toolbar buttons have aria-labels and aria-pressed (jamal) 6) persist view per workspace with clear opt-out and telemetry (rui/maya) 7) contrast + focus ring adjustments (sam/elena) design-bot: Frame 'compare-layouts' updated by sam. Labels: design-review, keyboard, hotkeys, accessibility. maya: thanks all. i'll update the figma frames and drop the new radiogroup components. can folks review before noon tomorrow? :thumbsup: sam: will do. short follow-up: can we also include a tiny inline help pill next to Lock that links to docs about routing guarantees? customer success will thank us. elena: good call. add link target `_blank` and `rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"`. maya: noted. closing thread; will reopen if new blockers crop up.
